notes: Added 5 stories for MAINT-TIMEOUT covering UX contract, core logic, UI behavior, cancellation/retry integration, and testing.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for timeout UX states
Added core logic story for timeout detection and state transitions
Added UI story for timeout modal and user actions
Added integration story for AbortController and request retry
Added test story for timeout handling

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S1.title: Define Timeout UX State Schema and Contract
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S1.description: Define frontend state model for long-running requests including states: pending, timeout_triggered, user_continue, user_abort, and completed. Ensure consistent state transitions for ChatWindow component.

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S2.title: Implement Timeout Detection and State Transition Logic
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S2.description: Implement 45-second timeout detection and trigger state transition to timeout_triggered. Handle user decisions (continue vs abandon) and resume or terminate request flow accordingly.

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S3.title: Render Timeout Modal with Continue/Abandon Actions
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S3.description: Implement UI modal that appears at timeout with clear options to continue waiting or abandon the request. Ensure accessibility and clear messaging.

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S4.title: Integrate AbortController and Retry/Continue Flow
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S4.description: Integrate AbortController to cancel in-flight requests on abandon and allow safe continuation or retry without duplicating requests or corrupting chat state.

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S5.title: Timeout Handling Test Suite (Unit + Integration)
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S5.description: Create tests validating timeout trigger at 45s, modal display, user actions (continue/abandon), request cancellation, and successful continuation behavior.
